message.text:
q05.

**8** services, all in the `memos.api.v1` package:

| Service | Proto file |
| --- | --- |
| `AIService` | `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` |
| `AttachmentService` | `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto` |
| `AuthService` | `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` |
| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` |
| `UserService` | `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto` |

Every `.proto` in that directory declares exactly one service, except `common.proto` (shared message/enum definitions only) and the `README.md`. The count is corroborated by the generated Connect bindings in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/`, which contains exactly eight `*.connect.go` files matching those services one-to-one.

Note that `IdentityProviderService` is the only one whose name doesn't match its filename (`idp_service.proto`).
